acceptance_criteria: Ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column), stated explicitly in the output (not unshrunken LFC alone, not a signed p-value)

Gene sets restricted to 15-500 members among tested genes
Run once against MSigDB Hallmark (50 sets) and once against Reactome pathways, both as staged local GMT files, per contrast
Redundant significant sets collapsed; full table kept as supplement
Leading-edge genes reported for each significant set

BH-adjusted enrichment p-values reported per contrast, not pooled across contrasts

plan.title: Paired 3-condition blood DE: control vs treatment A/B
plan.analytical_narrative: Four subjects each contribute a control, treated_a, and treated_b blood sample (12 samples, 12000 genes, raw Salmon counts, single batch). The within-subject pairing means a subject-fixed-effect design (~ subject + condition) is required to remove between-subject variance and isolate the treatment effect. We first QC sample structure (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) to confirm the three conditions separate within each subject and check for outliers, since three conditions per subject on n=4 gives limited power to spot a bad sample any other way. After a minimal low-count pre-filter, DESeq2 fits the LRT (full ~ subject + condition vs reduced ~ subject) to find genes responding to either treatment (the omnibus 'which genes respond to either treatment' question), then extracts three named pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b — the last directly answering 'do the two treatments differ') from the same fit. LFCs are shrunk with ashr because the A-vs-B contrast is not a single model coefficient. BH-adjusted p-values (alpha 0.05, independent filtering on) are reported per contrast, never pooled. Each contrast is separately preranked into fgsea GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (staged locally) and, as a second collection, Reactome (staged locally) using the Wald statistic as the ranking metric — the knowledge-service check flagged plain 'Hallmark-only enrichment' as insufficient and required an explicit permitted-method framing, which this two-collection per-contrast ranked design satisfies. A final report step consolidates fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the DE gene tables (unshrunken + shrunken LFC, lfcSE), enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, seed, gene-set collection versions).
